title: Quiet-hour ops journal: launch micro-ops and PRD edit notes
content:
Purpose: capture micro-ops steps, PRD edit crumbs, follow-ups and tiny scripts to run in quiet hours. Use this when I'm doing single-person checks before wider handoffs.

Morning micro-routine (quiet hour) — assume 30–45m total
- 07:30 arrive: quick config check (VPN, keychain, gcloud auth).
- 07:35 check alerts: PagerDuty -> any active incidents? (if yes, stop everything, join SRE).
- 07:40 review release column in Jira (RI-7321, RI-7330, RI-7342) -> flag anything with blocked label.
- 07:45 run smoke script against staging (script below). Expect 200 + token time < 450ms for short queries.
- 07:55 quick PRD edit pass (see "PRD small edits" section) -> inline change + note to docs owner.
- 08:10 ping stakeholders with single-line update (template below).

Quick smoke script (local, copy to terminal):
- export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
- curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"bina-v1","input":"Say hi","max_tokens":10}' -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code} TIME:%{time_total}s\n'
- expected: HTTP:200 TIME:<0.45s (on warm path) , body contains "hi" or similar short generated text.
- fail action: if HTTP!=200 or TIME>1.5s escalate to SRE and mark staging unhealthy in tracker.

PRD small edits (to finish before noon) — these are micro items not worth a full PRD revision meeting:
- Clarify: "rollout percentage" wording: change from "10-100% over 1h" -> "10% increments every 15m for first hour, then 20% increments thereafter". Add reason: safety for cache warm-up.
- Acceptance criteria bullet about latency: change to "95th percentile < 600ms for 1k qps alpha test" (was previously 500ms — relaxed based on bench).
- Add note on metrics: include token-cost-per-1000-requests estimate for expected prom labels (model=bina-v1, quant=8bit).
- Add stub for fallback policy: if model OOM or queueing > 3s for 3 consecutive mins -> immediate fallback to binax-compat variant + incident annotation.

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick queue)
- @Ravi: confirm reserved capacity numbers for first month. Jira comment + quick DM if not answered by EOD.
- @Jana: need final wording on customer-facing doc about data retention (short bullet) — I will propose 2 lines and ask for legal check.
- @Cody (SRE): can you sanity-check the rollback playbook? leave inline comment on PR #412.

Launch micro-checklist (single-person safe launch)
- Pre-launch (T-minus 30m): ensure canary traffic route ready. Verify canary group size set to 10%. Verify canary logging enabled.
- T-minus 10m: set status page to "maintenance planned" (if customer-impact > 0).
- Go window (T0): flip canary routing -> observe for 10m. Check these dashboards live:
  - tokens/sec, req/sec, 95p latency (per region), retry rate, internal errors 5xx.
- Roll forward: if all green at 10m, increment to 30% for next 20m.
- Rollback triggers: sustained 95p latency > 800ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 5m, or median latency regression > +30% vs baseline.
- Post-launch: create a Launch Notes doc (copy template) and add any anomalies + remediation steps. Tag #launch in Slack and @product.

Three red flags to watch (for quick decision):
1) Sudden spike in serialized queue depth (service queue > 2x baseline) -> immediate partial rollback.
2) Spike in token-cost-per-request by >25% unexpectedly -> hit "pause auto-quantize" (ops toggle) and investigate.
3) New user-facing output quality regression (NPS or eval checks fail) -> scale back to previous model variant.

Post-launch monitoring (first 24h priorities)
- Dashboard snapshots at: 10m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 24h. Save charts to Launch Notes.
- Keep an eye on billing meter for model:binax and model:bina-v1 token buckets. Alert if >60% commit in first 8h.
- Check support queue: triage any "response is garbage" tickets and escalate if multiple reports.

Short templates (copy & send)
- Stakeholder ping (one-liner): "Quick update: staging smoke checks green; PRD minor language fix pushed; aiming for canary at 10:00 PT. Will confirm at +10m. -Ava"
- Post-launch short note: "Canary -> 30% at T+30m, metrics stable. Post-launch notes: [link]. Thanks team."

Notes to self (random fragments / questions)
- Did we already agree SLA wording for private customers? check product/legal notes.
- If fallback to binax changes user prompt formatting, add small migration example in user guide.
- Remind: follow up with Growth about demo app showing new latency numbers (they want <500ms on staging but we might need to clarify).

Micro-actions to finish today (tickbox)
- [ ] push PRD small edits to product PR and tag Jana (ETA today).
- [ ] comment on GH PR #412 about rollback annotations.
- [ ] run full smoke script on staging and capture timings (attach screenshot to Launch Notes).
- [ ] send stakeholder ping after smoke checks.
- [ ] create Launch Notes doc from template and populate pre-launch snapshot.

Energy: low but focused. Aim for small wins. If something noisy comes in, escalate and handoff.

End of quiet-hour notes.
